# interfere_verified_domain (Resource)

Manage a workspace email domain and how people with an address at it join the workspace. Creation returns while verification is pending; a workspace admin verifies the domain in the dashboard, and verification_status refreshes on the next plan. Automatic enrollment modes require a verified domain, so create the domain with manual_invitation and change enrollment_mode after verification. Domains managed by an enterprise SSO connection cannot be managed here. Import with workspace-slug/domain-name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "interfere_verified_domain" "company" {
  workspace_slug  = "example"
  name            = "example.com"
  enrollment_mode = "manual_invitation"
}

output "domain_verification_status" {
  value = interfere_verified_domain.company.verification_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Lowercase email domain, such as example.com.
- `workspace_slug` (String) Workspace URL slug, using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

### Optional

- `enrollment_mode` (String) How people with an email address at this domain join the workspace: manual_invitation (an admin invites them), automatic_invitation (they are invited automatically) or automatic_suggestion (they are offered to request to join). Automatic modes require a verified domain. Defaults to manual_invitation.

### Read-Only

- `affiliation_email_address` (String) Email address used to verify the domain. Null until verification starts.
- `clerk_domain_id` (String) Identifier of the domain in the sign-in service.
- `id` (String) Unique verified domain identifier.
- `verification_status` (String) Domain verification status: pending or verified. Verification happens outside Terraform and is read on refresh.
- `verified_at` (Number) When the domain was verified, in Unix milliseconds. Null while verification is pending.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import interfere_verified_domain.company example/example.com
```
